label: Calendar
depicts: Blank calendar page with top binder tabs and an empty lower panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants a generic calendar symbol without visible dates or numbers.
avoid_when: Do not use for dated calendar variants when the lower panel should stay blank.

label: Calendar
depicts: Calendar page with top binder tabs and six small date dots
use_when: Use when the interface wants a calendar that explicitly shows small date markers inside the page.
avoid_when: Do not use for the blank or numbered calendar variants when the six interior dots matter.

label: Calendar
depicts: Tear off calendar block with the number ten on the front panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants a tear off day block rather than a full hanging calendar page.
avoid_when: Do not use for the hanging calendar page icons when the bold number on a block should remain visible.

label: Coin
depicts: Coin outline from the side with a thin oval cylinder body
use_when: Use when the interface wants the simplest single coin profile without extra stack bands.
avoid_when: Do not use for stacked or gem like coins when the single thin coin edge matters.

label: Coin
depicts: Stacked coin cylinder with two horizontal bands across the body
use_when: Use when the interface wants a taller stacked coin form rather than a single flat coin.
avoid_when: Do not use for the single coin profile when the stacked cylinder bands are visible.
